verses.1: And all those who were sinners and evil people were forced to listen to him.
verses.2: And the Pharisees and the scribes also disputed, saying that this man was a sinner who deserved to be punished.
verses.3: And he said this parable to them.
verses.4: Who among you has ten sheep? If he loses one of them, he still doesn’t abandon the other nine in the wilderness. He continues to walk toward the place where he lost his sheep until he finds it again.
verses.5: And when they found them, they rushed towards them, laughing.
verses.6: And when he went into his house, he gathered his friends and neighbors together, saying to them, “Thank you for finding my sheep that was lost.”
verses.7: I say to you that it will be a joy in heaven for one who repents, or for those ninety innocent people who have no need of repentance at all.
verses.8: What kind of woman would have ten coins? If she loses one coin, won’t she be unable to afford to buy anything or keep up with her household expenses? She will have to wait carefully until she gets the money back.
verses.9: And when she saw this, she called together her friends and neighbors and said, “Please forgive me for losing the money I had lost.”
verses.10: In this way, I say to you, joy is found before the messengers of God, when a sinner repentes.
verses.11: He said, “A man had two sons.”
verses.12: And the younger of them said to their father, “Father, give me a portion of your substance.” But he continued to provide for their living expenses.
verses.13: And after many days, the younger son was brought back to his homeland. There, he wasted away and died in a state of utter misery.
verses.14: After he spent all his money, a severe famine occurred in that region. He began to suffer greatly as a result.
verses.15: And when he was taken away by the people of that land, they sent him into the fields where he could raise chickens.
verses.16: And they wanted to fill his belly with those grains of grain that the farmers had harvested. But no one gave him any of them.
verses.17: When he came to himself, he said, “How many of my ancestors have wasted away due to excessive eating! I, on the other hand, am still alive.”
verses.18: I will go back to my father and tell him what has happened. Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.
verses.19: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Please treat me as one of your workers, just like you do with others who work for you.
verses.20: And he went to his father in distress. Still, when his father was far away, his father saw him and became very sad. He fell on his face and hugged him tightly.
verses.21: But the son said to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.”
verses.22: And the father said to his servants, “Quickly, put on the first garment, and then wear it. Also, give him a ring to be worn on his finger, and clothes for his feet.”
verses.23: And bring the offering of the grain, offer it as an offering. After eating it, we will be satisfied.
verses.24: Because this son of mine was dead and then revived. He was buried and found alive. And they began to rejoice.
verses.25: And his son, the older one, was in the field. As he approached, he heard music and singing coming from the house.
verses.26: And when he invited one of the boys to sit down, he asked what those things meant.
verses.27: And he said to him that his brother was there. Also, your father gave up the slave who was a food provider, because he had accepted him as a healthy person.
verses.28: He was also upset and didn’t want to go in. But his father went out and called him along with him.
verses.29: But the man who answered said to his father, “Look, I have served you for so many years, and yet you never gave me any orders. You never gave me any gifts to help me feel happy with my friends.”
verses.30: And when your son, who ate your life along with the prostitutes, came back, I gave him the food that was meant for the merchants.
verses.31: And he said to him, “Son, always stay with me. Everything that belongs to me, you will also have.”
verses.32: It should also be pleasant and joyful to know that your brother was dead, but then he came back to life. He was buried, and now he’s alive again.
